defs.meaning: 流行，时尚，潮流；乐队花车；（尤指政客追赶的）浪头

examples.en: The World Cup bandwagon is starting to roll.
examples.zh: 世界杯足球赛热潮即将涌起。

examples.en: The bandwagon was big enough for any johnny-come-lately.
examples.zh: 这股潮流对任何新来的人来说都足够了。

examples.en: Almost everybody has leapt on the bandwagon.
examples.zh: 几乎每所学校都搭上了这班变革列车。
